about_the_game:
Haunted Forest Tileset is a collection of pixelart tileset material to create a dark and moody forest for your game.

 

Haunted and foreboding, this darker theme includes assets for old pathways through the forest, gravesites, and spooky pumpkins! Suited for both normal and parallax mapping.

 

Includes:

●     Grass and dirt grass tiles

●     Animated water tiles for all ground types

●     Animated waterfall

●     Cliff tiles

●     3 variations of stone fence tiles: Normal, Broken and Moss-covered

●     3 large trees, and 2 dead trees

●     Pumpkins, normal and carved!

●     Cobwebs

●     Bone remnants, on the ground and on sticks

●     An assortment of bushes, grasses, mushrooms and roots

●     Rocks and shovels for burying your secrets

●     Tombstones and a fresh grave

 

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

 

【tilesets (4 sheets)】

 

●     A1 tiles：1 sheets

●     A2 tiles：1 sheets

●     A4 tiles：1 sheets

●     B tiles：1 sheets

 

 

【character (1 sheets)】

 

●     Water shimmer

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------

 

 ・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
